skill.name: php-static-analysis
skill.description: Implementation guidance for making PHP code provably typed under a strict static analyzer.
skill.author: Agent Skills Team

name: php-static-analysis
description: Native types first, precise shapes and generics, honest contracts, root-cause typing, scoped ignores, and analyzer extensions.

categories.name: Native Types First
categories.description: Prefer enforceable native PHP types and strict comparisons before PHPDoc workarounds

categories.name: Shape & Generic Precision
categories.description: Use precise shapes, lists, generics, class-strings, and refined strings instead of loose mixed values

categories.name: Contract Honesty
categories.description: Preserve correct strict contracts and prove boundary validity instead of widening types to silence analysis

categories.name: Root-Cause Typing
categories.description: Type producers and factories at the source instead of repeating inline assertions at callers

categories.name: Scoped Ignores & Analyzer Extensions
categories.description: Keep suppressions narrow and teach analyzers reusable dynamic behavior through supported extensions
